kingdom-of-england ledger/96 (1649-05, England + Wales, counterpart commonwealth-of-england) changed merge -> loss. Compiler read: merge() with a living counterpart absorbs the side holding less of the region (held_by(did) >= held_by(cp)), so after commonwealth-of-england's found of the same month (counterpart kingdom-of-england, so allowed to take its cells) the kingdom with 0 cells absorbed the Commonwealth's 649 back; a loss gives only what the kingdom still holds to the living Commonwealth, a no-op after the found and a full hand-over if the found took less. The kingdom lives on to 1707 (no dissolve in 1649), so nothing else depends on the merge. Page: Act 'adopted by the Rump Parliament on 19 May 1649', 'all the Dominions and Territories thereunto belonging', 1649 to 1660. Not confirmed by a compile run; patch p1650-p1659 events/0 should be checked after the next compile. Validates (2 older first-barons-war-rebels warnings).
